description: Lets KnoxCall send email (workflow mail, alerts and invitations) from this domain by publishing the DKIM key, return-path MX and SPF include its mail provider requires.
variableDescription: dkim: the DKIM public key body issued for this domain (the value after p=). mx: the return-path MX host for the domain’s mail region, e.g. feedback-smtp.us-east-1.amazonses.com.
